desc: Task 0 — Ideation: min-multiple-per-divisor sieve approach with soundness/completeness proof.
Task 1 — Full implementation: big/small partition, `present` bytearray, inlined DSU (path halving + union by size), sieve union loop with analytic `lim = T*d//s` bound, component counter.
Task 3 — Verification: examples (4 and 2 ✔), edge cases (n=1, all big, value 1, threshold=1, duplicates), correctness proof vs brute force, worst-case timing analysis.
Task 4 — Performance tuning: `small==1` fast return, root fast-path, early break at `comp==1` (kills worst case); est. ≤0.8s at T=2·10⁵.
